description: Erection of a side and rear dormer with a front rooflight and a rear solar tube to the house and increase in height of the existing outbuilding and installation of a pergola.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Design and Access Statement, Energy and sustainability, A3/01 A, A3/02 A, A3/03 A, A3/04 A, A3/05 A, A3/06 A, Fire Statement, Flood Risk Statement, A3/99 A, A3/12 A, A3/10 A, A3/11 A received 29/06/2026
A3/09 B, A3/07 B, A3/08 B received 19/08/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '4 Flanders Road W4 1NG' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby permitted shall not be commenced until the following documents (in consultation with London Underground), for each progressive stage of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which:
a)           Provide details on the use of tall plant, scaffolding, and lifting equipment, ensuring that no oversailing of adjoining operational railway and the risk of collapse of temporary works and plant is mitigated.
b)           Provide in plan and design that no part of the proposed outbuilding roof including tiles, eaves, gutters, fasciae, or any projection will not be overhanging or encroach onto LUL airspace.
c)           The applicant will need to demonstrate that the works during and upon completion will not increase the risk of trespass or unauthorised access onto LUL premises.
Reason: To ensure that the development does not impact on existing London Underground/DLR transport infrastructure, in accordance with the London Plan 2021 Policy T3 and Sustainable Transport Walking and Cycling London Plan Guidance 2022.

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the east elevation roof extension shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 7 - The window(s) to be fitted on the [front/rear] roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
Reason: In order to safeguard the architectural and historic interest of the [conservation area/listed building].
